ORDINANCE LII OF 1979
ORDINANCE LII OF 1979
POLITICAL PARTIES (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Political Parties Act, 1962
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th September 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Political Parties (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3-B, Act III of 1962

following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
2. Amendment o section 3‑B, Act III of 1962.‑In the
Political Parties Act, 1962 (III of 1962 in section 3‑B,‑
(a) in subsection (3),‑‑
(i) in clause (a), for the word
"annually" the word "periodically" shall be substituted;
(ii) in clause (b), the word
"and" at the end shall be omitted;
(iii) in clause (c), for the full‑stop
at the end the semi‑colon and word "; and" shall be
substituted; and
(iv) after clause (c), amended as
aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added, namely :‑
"(d) has submitted its
accounts as required by section 3‑A"; and
(b) in subsection (4), in clause
(a), after the word "fails", the commas and words ", or has
failed," shall be inserted, or has failed. Shall be inserted.
